text:
violet: saw weird behavior in Android sample: when phone switches cell towers the stream sometimes drops or emits combined payloads.
violet: server is sending correct SSE with blank lines between events but client sees two events merged or treats blank line as EOF.
omar: do you have a tiny repro?
violet: yes: simple netcat loop that emits event, blank line, event. On flaky network the TCP recv can return the two events in one buffer and our parser emits a single combined event.
jen: sounds like buffer reassembly bug. Parsers must iterate lines and treat empty-line as separator even if split across reads.
omar: also add a small dedupe on Last-Event-ID during reconnects; we saw duplicated final token once.
jen: I'll add unit tests for split-token cases (
 mid-line,  only, and extra CRLF heartbeats).
ci-bot: created INF-2102, branch: sdk-fix/sse-reassembly-mobile. PR: https://git.redwood/internal/pr/5120
violet: note for docs: add a short note in devex/sdks.md about mobile network coalescing and point to a tiny fuzz script to simulate splits.
jen: will do. TL;DR: fix reassembly, treat blank lines as heartbeats, add resume dedupe option and fuzz tests.
